scope: The existing St. George’s Cathedral in Cape Town as photographed on 1 January 2006, including the Wale Street north transept, nave, chancel and side aisles within the named mapped church outline.

originalReview.notes: The Wale Street view shows the projecting stone north transept, tall traceried window in a deeply recessed arch, paired lower entrance arches, stepped buttresses, sandstone ashlar and muted red roof.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact published Qualla original matches the only Commons file upload. Mike Hayes is the author and original uploader and applied the own-work public-domain release. The 1901 foundation ceremony image was excluded from the 2006 exterior scope.
